misc.title: Who is God, and What does it mean tho be human
misc.subtitle:
Short description: Knowing who God is and who we are is the foundation of all other knowledge. In this course, we will spend the first semester exploring what the Bible teaches us about God’s nature, His character, and the ultimate purposes of life. In the second semester, we will delve into the nature of humanity, examining how we are created in God’s image, the purpose of our creation, the reality of our fallenness, and the Redemption that restore us to our original purpose.

(Remember, these courses are designed for you to collaborate with other homeschool families who share similar educational visions. Identify one, two, or five families and establish a small homeschool coop. Organize one weekly meetings where your high school students can complete the group video lesson and group learning assignments together. This approach aligns with the ideal way to utilize online courses. Cooperative learning should never be replaced by technology.)

course-squares-2.title: Who is God (Semester 1)
course-squares-2.descrition:
• There is only one true God.
  • God is a spirit (God is an “I” and not a thing).

  • The ultimate ends for which God created.
